content.title: blockade, v. meanings, etymology and more
content.text: There are two meanings listed in OED's entry for the verb blockade. Originally Military. To seal off (a place, esp. a port) as an act of war; to subject to a blockade. Now also: to prevent access to (a place) as a civilian protest.1684To quarter round about Caminiec, and strictly Blockade that place.
